stances.claim: 'Two close friends passed away last week a few days after my Leni had gone' - the column opens framed by triple bereavement (CJ's wife Leni, then OML, then ADR).

Oscar M. Lopez 'Oskie' (93) 'was a man of honor, dignity, and integrity; he was courageous, patriotic, and - when appropriate - quixotic' - exemplified by his rejection during the FPH-First Pacific consortium's NLEx-concession sale to MPIC of an unsolicited counteroffer P500 million higher: 'No sir, I will not break my word of honor for P500 million, or for any amount.'

OML displayed courage and patriotism at annual FPH shareholders' meetings by criticizing sitting Philippine presidents 'without fear of their ire' - yet he never abused his closeness to advance his business interests, a pattern CJ 'personally witnessed' as an FPH director sitting beside OML at monthly board meetings, including during the close OML-PNoy Aquino III relationship of 2010-2016.
stances.rhetorical_move: principle-with-self-restraint pattern plus first-hand witness testimony

stances.claim: In December 2016 just before Christmas, OML, his wife Connie, and his baritone son Piki visited CJ's home and serenaded CJ and his wife Leni - making up for missing CJ's '80th-birthday musicale, the Ageless Passion of Art Panganiban' at Maybank Theater featuring Ryan Cayabyab and Jeff Agustin. Piki's eulogy invoked the La Mancha Don Quixote figurine OML brought home 14 years before as emblem of OML's quixotic dream-big legacy.

Albert F. Del Rosario 'ADR' (83) and CJ had been close friends for over 40 years - 'the triumvirate of business titans Lim-Panganiban-Del Rosario who, as Mr. Chairman, broke bread together every month' until the quartet 'lost' Doming Lim in the 1990s and lost CJ when he joined the SC; tennis with ADR and his wife Gretchen continued at Manila Polo Club, Wimbledon, and Roland Garros.

Per ADR's Ateneo de Manila honorary Doctor of Humanities prologue: 'It is said that a nation has four elements: its people, territory, government, and sovereignty. Albert F. Del Rosario has defended and promoted all of these' - including the protection of OFWs and the West Philippine Sea Arbitral Award.
stances.rhetorical_move: honorary-degree citation as authoritative summary of ADR's nation-defending vocation

stances.claim: Quixotically, ADR with retired Justice Conchita Carpio Morales filed an ICC complaint against Xi Jinping for crimes against humanity - thrown out for lack of jurisdiction since China was never an ICC member, with the consequence that ADR was banned from Hong Kong.
Closer: 'Adieu, my dear quixotic and patriotic friends. Well done on your earthly sojourn. Till we meet again in the peace and love of our Father in Heaven.'

notable_anecdotes: The opening line 'Two close friends passed away last week a few days after my Leni had gone' - making this column the most explicit textual marker of CJ's wife Leni's recent death (NOT to be confused with VP Leni Robredo, who is a distinct figure in CJ's E-series). The bereavement frame governs the entire eulogy.

OML's 'No sir, I will not break my word of honor for P500 million, or for any amount' - one of the most quotable single-line corporate-ethics statements in CJ's tribute columns, anchoring the entire OML virtue-catalog in a single dispositive event.
OML's annual FPH shareholders' meeting critique of sitting Philippine presidents - the recurring institutional practice testifying to the courageous-and-patriotic-but-never-exploitative pattern.
CJ's first-hand FPH-director witness testimony to the OML-PNoy Aquino III closeness-without-exploitation pattern (2010-2016) - making CJ a participant-observer in the very pattern he eulogizes.

The December 2016 home-visit serenade vignette - intimate domestic detail anchoring the OML friendship in CJ's own family life, with the specific named cultural reference to the 'Ageless Passion of Art Panganiban' musicale at Maybank Theater featuring Ryan Cayabyab and Jeff Agustin.
Piki Lopez's La Mancha Don Quixote figurine eulogy - emblematic-object pedagogy as eulogy device, with the 14-year provenance detail.

The 'Mr. Chairman' triumvirate of Lim-Panganiban-Del Rosario - one of CJ's most explicit personal-history disclosures of his pre-SC business-circle friendships, with the dual loss-of-membership pattern (Doming Lim's death; CJ's SC entry).
Tennis at Manila Polo Club, Wimbledon, Roland Garros - tight three-venue trio establishing the ADR friendship as transnational-leisure register.

ADR's Ateneo honorary Doctor of Humanities prologue verbatim quotation - one of CJ's most clean institutional-citation-as-summary moves, naming the four elements of nationhood (people, territory, government, sovereignty) ADR defended.

The ICC complaint vs Xi Jinping (with Justice Conchita Carpio Morales) - thrown out for lack of jurisdiction (China never an ICC member), with ADR consequently banned from Hong Kong. Preserved as the canonical 'quixotic and patriotic' act unifying ADR's character with the column's title adjectives.
The 'Adieu... Till we meet again in the peace and love of our Father in Heaven' closer - CJ's signature confessional-faith eulogistic register applied to twin tributes.

one_paragraph_summary: Panganiban delivers a twin eulogistic tribute opening with the personal-bereavement marker 'Two close friends passed away last week a few days after my Leni had gone' (his wife Leni, distinct from VP Leni Robredo). Oscar M. Lopez ('Oskie,' 93), chair of First Philippine Holdings, was 'a man of honor, dignity, and integrity; he was courageous, patriotic, and - when appropriate - quixotic,' exemplified by his rejection during the FPH-First Pacific consortium's NLEx-concession sale to MPIC of an unsolicited counteroffer P500 million higher: 'No sir, I will not break my word of honor for P500 million, or for any amount.' OML displayed courage and patriotism at annual FPH shareholders' meetings by criticizing sitting Philippine presidents 'without fear of their ire' - yet he never abused his closeness to advance business interests, a pattern Panganiban 'personally witnessed' as an FPH director sitting beside him at monthly board meetings, including throughout OML's close relationship with PNoy Aquino III (2010-2016). In December 2016 just before Christmas, OML, his wife Connie, and his baritone son Piki visited CJ's home and serenaded him and Leni - making up for missing CJ's '80th-birthday musicale, the Ageless Passion of Art Panganiban' at Maybank Theater featuring Ryan Cayabyab and Jeff Agustin. Piki's eulogy invoked the La Mancha Don Quixote figurine OML brought home 14 years before as emblem of OML's quixotic dream-big legacy. Albert F. Del Rosario ('ADR,' 83) had been Panganiban's close friend for over 40 years - 'the triumvirate of business titans Lim-Panganiban-Del Rosario who, as Mr. Chairman, broke bread together every month' until the quartet 'lost' Doming Lim in the 1990s and lost CJ when he joined the Supreme Court; tennis with ADR and his wife Gretchen continued at Manila Polo Club, Wimbledon, and Roland Garros. Per ADR's Ateneo de Manila honorary Doctor of Humanities prologue: 'It is said that a nation has four elements: its people, territory, government, and sovereignty. Albert F. Del Rosario has defended and promoted all of these,' including the protection of OFWs and the West Philippine Sea Arbitral Award. Quixotically, ADR with retired Justice Conchita Carpio Morales filed an ICC complaint against Xi Jinping for crimes against humanity - thrown out for lack of jurisdiction since China was never an ICC member, with the consequence that ADR was banned from Hong Kong. Panganiban closes: 'Adieu, my dear quixotic and patriotic friends. Well done on your earthly sojourn. Till we meet again in the peace and love of our Father in Heaven.'
